title: Projection-compatible spectrum presentation of a base-changed affine chart
statement: Let $z:Z\to S$ and $t:T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $W\subset S$, $V\subset Z$ be opens with $V\subset z^{-1}(W)$. Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $A,B$ commutative $R$-algebras. Suppose $e_0:W\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$, $e_B:V\cong\operatorname{Spec}B$ and $e:t^{-1}(W)\cong\operatorname{Spec}A$ are isomorphisms [def-weil-affine-spectrum] commuting with the maps to $W$ and the specified structure maps to $\operatorname{Spec}R$. Write $p:Z\times_ST\to Z$, $q:Z\times_ST\to T$ for the projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. There is an isomorphism $i:p^{-1}(V)\cong\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_R B)$ such that $p\circ\iota\circ i^{-1}=\iota_V\circ e_B^{-1}\circ\operatorname{Spec}(b\mapsto1\otimes b)$ and $q\circ\iota\circ i^{-1}=\iota_{t^{-1}(W)}\circ e^{-1}\circ\operatorname{Spec}(a\mapsto a\otimes1)$, where $\iota$ denotes the open-subscheme inclusion. Zero rings and empty opens are allowed.

proof.text: Map the affine pullback Spec(B) ×[Spec(R)] Spec(A) to Z ×[S] T using the specified presentations and the chart inclusions. The two compatibility equations make this a map of diagrams. It is an open immersion with image p⁻¹(V) ∩ q⁻¹(t⁻¹(W)), by the open fibre-product lemma. The containment V⊆z⁻¹(W) and p≫z=q≫t imply p⁻¹(V)⊆q⁻¹(t⁻¹(W)); hence the image is p⁻¹(V). The two open immersions with this same image give an isomorphism with the inverse-image open subscheme.

proof.text: Compose the inverse of the open-subscheme isomorphism with pullback symmetry and pullbackSpecIso R A B. The projection equations of pullback.map, pullback symmetry and pullbackSpecIso show that its inverse projects to Spec(includeRight)≫eB⁻¹≫ιV and Spec(includeLeft)≫e⁻¹≫ι(t⁻¹W), respectively. No nonzero-ring or nonempty-chart hypothesis is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineChart_baseChangeIso
    {S Z : Scheme.{u}} (z : Z ⟶ S)
    (W : S.Opens) (V : Z.Opens) (eV : V ≤ z ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (R B : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra R B]
    (e0 : W.toScheme ≅ Spec R) (eB : V.toScheme ≅ Spec B)
    (hB : z.resLE W V eV ≫ e0.hom =
      eB.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ S) (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra R A]
    (e : (t ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ≅ Spec A)
    (h : t.resLE W _ le_rfl ≫ e0.hom =
      e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))) :
    ∃ i : ((pullback.fst z t) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ≅ Spec (.of (A ⊗[R] B)),
      i.inv ≫ ((pullback.fst z t) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ pullback.fst z t =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) ≫
          eB.inv ≫ V.ι ∧
      i.inv ≫ ((pullback.fst z t) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ pullback.snd z t =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom) ≫
          e.inv ≫ (t ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι
